name: io.github.Labs64/netlicensing-mcp
title: NetLicensing MCP Server
description: Official Labs64 NetLicensing MCP server: manage products, licensees, licenses and entitlements.

environmentVariables.name: NETLICENSING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your NetLicensing API key. Required unless NETLICENSING_ALLOW_DEMO is true.

environmentVariables.name: NETLICENSING_ALLOW_DEMO
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to run against the NetLicensing sandbox with demo credentials. Never use in production.

environmentVariables.name: NETLICENSING_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the NetLicensing API base URL

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode: stdio (default) or http

environmentVariables.name: MCP_VERBOSE
environmentVariables.description: Enable verbose debug logging (true/false)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind address in HTTP mode

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Bind port in HTTP mode

environmentVariables.name: MCP_REDACT_FIELDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated extra field names to redact from responses and logs

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to register: products, bundles, modules, templates, licensees, licenses, tokens, transactions, payments, system, workflows, or all

environmentVariables.name: MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Register only read-only tools (true/false)
